title: proof-java configuration file
description: Repo-level configuration (docs/M0-CLI-INPUT.md). Option precedence: command line > config file > documented defaults. Strict JSON: no comments, no unknown keys. Entries that need rationale carry an explicit reason field rather than a comment.

languageLevel.description: Java language level for JavaParser. CLI --language-level overrides this.

encoding.description: Charset used to read test sources. CLI --encoding overrides this.

coverageExclusions.description: sonar.coverage.exclusions globs (D-05). CLI --coverage-exclusions overrides this list entirely; the two are never merged.

findingsScope.description: Which test sources the L0 oracle rules scan. CLI --findings-scope overrides this.

customOracles.description: fully.qualified.Type#methodPattern entries; glob * is allowed in the method part only (docs/rules/README.md). A resolved call matching an entry is an oracle.

modules.description: Module/report/classpath bindings (D-66), the same shape --module/--report/--per-test-classpath/--mutation-classpath express on the command line - 'proof-java doctor --write-config' generates this. Applies only when the command line declares zero --module flags; a single --module on the command line ignores this array entirely rather than partially merging with it (same all-or-nothing rule as coverageExclusions).

root.description: Repo-relative, forward-slash. '.' for a single-module repo.

report.description: Repo-relative path to this module's JaCoCo XML. A module with none is excluded from the analyzed set (MODULE_WITHOUT_REPORT), same as an unbound --module.

suppressions.description: Suppressed findings are not listed but are counted in a SUPPRESSED_FINDINGS warning, so they stay visible (hard rule 3a).
